Item Crafting System (Kibbles' Crafting Guide)

This crafting system is designed for the adventuring lifestyle: fast, intuitive, and paced in 2-hour increments (ideal for short rests, camp actions, or travel downtime).

How Crafting Works:

  1. Select an Item: Choose the recipe you want to craft.
  2. Gather Materials: Materials can be purchased, looted, harvested from creatures, or gathered in the wilderness.
  3. Crafting Modifier: Crafting Modifier = Tool Proficiency Bonus + Relevant Ability Score Modifier
  4. Progress in 2-Hour Blocks: For every 2 hours spent, roll 1d20 + Crafting Modifier against the recipe's DC.
    • Success: Add 2 hours of progress toward completion.
    • Failure: No progress made. If you fail 3 times in a row, the craft fails and materials are ruined.
  5. Completion: Once total progress equals the required time, the item is finished!
  6. Taking 10: You can take 10 by doubling the crafting time if 10 + your Crafting Modifier equals or exceeds the DC.

Creature Harvesting and Magical Remnants

Upon defeating monsters, adventurers can harvest valuable reagents and essences instead of mundane loot.

Required Skills:

  • Dragons and Monstrosities: Wisdom (Medicine)
  • Constructs: Intelligence (Arcana)
  • Plants: Intelligence (Nature)
  • Beasts and Basic Hide: Wisdom (Survival)

Basic or exotic harvesting takes 10 minutes. Celestials, Elementals, and Fiends leave behind Magical Remnants in 1 minute without requiring a check.
